argument: The chapter is not yet publishable as a unit; concrete structural and completeness work is required. Cross-references: the chapter's sole explicit reference (line 100) lands in the built PDF as a doubled period and a chapter number one low (the contents page and the chapter opener both number Armor & Shields as Chapter 18 while the reference cites 17); the same defect recurs wherever chapter references resolve (Equipment, Disciplines), so the repair is book-wide, not a ch06-only edit. Duplication: the Combat chapter explicitly points readers here for the full rule, then re-lists the same three defense formulas, the same reversed outcome table, and the same worked defense examples, creating drift risk; this chapter is the correct canonical home and Combat's restatement is the duplication to remove. Placement is otherwise sound: Difficulty Modifiers belong in this chapter, and the GM chapter only comments on applying them without reproducing the ladder, so no duplication exists there. Completeness: the worked-example set exercises the attack roll and skill checks but never an opposed roll or a Boon/Bane, and the Critical and Fumble sections are written only for the attacking roller, leaving three-6s or three-1s on a Defense Roll unstated even though the social-conflict chapter sources the general rule to this chapter; minimum additions are one opposed-roll example, one Boon/Bane example, and a sentence covering Critical/Fumble on a Defense Roll. Conventions: the three unnumbered tables are a partial book-wide convention (chapters 2 and 13 also mix numbered and unnumbered), so a ch06-only edit is not warranted; the collapsed defense enum at line 91 has the same multi-line shape in five other chapters and the bullet-as-number substitution is book-wide, so both need a scope ruling rather than a chapter patch.
